workload_class_rules.unique-task-document: Unique text candidates for substantive read or explicit document-role disposition; not all are proven substantive by filename alone.
workload_class_rules.structured-evidence: Claim-dependent bounded schema/coverage/receipt review, not automatically a full text-document read.
workload_class_rules.binary-or-supporting-snapshot: Role/metadata disposition plus visual/binary inspection only where needed to adjudicate a named claim. Metadata does not establish content or visual acceptance.
workload_class_rules.duplicate-scope-check: Exact representative hash and its reviewed scope must be resolved; copies do not each create a new deep-document obligation.
